Questions

Blue Mountains landscaping, answered.

Do you cover the whole Blue Mountains?

Yes — from the lower Mountains at Glenbrook and Blaxland through Springwood and Faulconbridge up to Katoomba, Leura and Blackheath. Tell us your suburb and we'll confirm.

How much does landscaping cost up here?

Every block is different, so we quote each job on its own and give you a clear, fixed written quote before any work starts.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — we hold the appropriate licences and public liability insurance, and we're happy to provide details with your quote.

Do you handle steep and bushfire-prone blocks?

Absolutely. We build retaining and drainage to suit the slope and can plan gardens with bushfire and APZ considerations in mind.
